name: Avoid instant at specialty cafés
question: Why should a rep not sell Frappé Instant to a specialty café?
expected_answer: Instant or budget lines in a specialty café that buys our premium espresso undercut the story we sold them; we protect the premium position of our espresso.

name: Fix before you sell
question: The customer has an open problem. Should I pitch a new product first?
expected_answer: No. Fix before you sell: a customer with an open problem gets a fix and a date before any new product.

name: Honest promises
question: A product is out of stock. What do we promise?
expected_answer: Never promise a delivery we cannot keep; say stock is short and do not push it.
